items.stem:
Under ANSI/ARMA 12-2005, a clerk files these folders alphabetically. Which name goes FIRST?
Ana dela Cruz | Ben Del Rosario | Carlo De Guzman | Dina Delos Reyes

reveal.terms: Indexing writes a name as filing units: surname, given name, middle initial for people; words as written for businesses. Compare unit by unit, letter by letter.
reveal.shortcut: Rewrite each name in indexed form first, then sort the rewritten forms.
reveal.why_correct: "Carlo De Guzman" is filed first. Indexed order: DEGUZMAN / CARLO; DELACRUZ / ANA; DELOSREYES / DINA; DELROSARIO / BEN. A surname prefix (de, dela, del, delos, san) joins the rest of the surname as one unit, and Mc is spelled as written (ARMA Rule 6). This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 6), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.

why_wrong.o1: "Ben Del Rosario" indexes as DELROSARIO / BEN and files fourth, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: a prefix joins the rest of the surname as one unit.
why_wrong.o2: "Dina Delos Reyes" indexes as DELOSREYES / DINA and files third, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: a prefix joins the rest of the surname as one unit.
why_wrong.o4: "Ana dela Cruz" indexes as DELACRUZ / ANA and files second, so it is not first. Picking it ignores this: compare unit by unit, letter by letter; nothing comes before something.
